page_title: BAY 2-0 WOL | Bayern Munich v Wolfsburg 12/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
90+3' Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+2' A player from Wolfsburg commits a rough challenge. Bastian Dankert blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' The referee allows time for a substitution. Lovro Zvonarek will be replaced by Jonathan Asp Jensen (Bayern Munich).
89' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
87' 4:0 – the corner kicks stats.
85' Ralph Hasenhuttl prepares a substitution. Jonas Wind is replaced by Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg).
85' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bayern Munich.
83' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
81' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) replaces Kevin Paredes.
79' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to substitute Ridle Baku and he is replaced by Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg).
79' The attendance for today's match is 75000.
78' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
74' Today's match ends for Min-Jae Kim who will be replaced by Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich).
74' Substitution. Bryan Zaragoza did his best and is replaced by Matteo Perez Vinlof (Bayern Munich).
74' Thomas Tuchel decides to make a substitution. Leon Goretzka will be replaced by Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich).
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. Daniel Peretz (Bayern Munich) for Manuel Neuer.
70' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
66' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
65' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Bayern Munich.

63' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
62' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the free kick and curls the ball just over the crossbar. That was close! The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
61' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) commits a rough foul. Bastian Dankert stops the game and makes a call. Bayern Munich win a free kick.
60' Bayern Munich enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
56' Bryan Zaragoza (Bayern Munich) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Koen Casteels, who makes a comfortable save.
55' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastian Dankert had an easy-decision to make.
51' Wolfsburg are ruled offside.
50' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Half-time substitution. Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) is replaced by Cedric Zesiger.
46' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Jakub Kaminski comes on the pitch for Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) makes a rough challenge and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.
42' Corner kick. Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is ready to send the ball into the box.
42' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Bayern Munich will take a corner kick.
41' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
38' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but Koen Casteels comes off his line to gather the ball.
35' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) meets a cross inside the box, but Koen Casteels wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
34' Neat passing move from Bayern Munich in order to create new attacking opportunities. The ratio of the ball possession is 66:34.
32' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Bastian Dankert blows for a foul.
29' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Bayern Munich was in an offside position.
28' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
27' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
24' The ball is cleared after Bryan Zaragoza (Bayern Munich) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
22' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Manuel Neuer was alert and made a comfortable save.
21' Lovro Zvonarek (Bayern Munich) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
20' Celebrations are cut short for Bayern Munich as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
19' The Bayern Munich players halt their celebrations as referee Bastian Dankert makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
18' Bryan Zaragoza (Bayern Munich) receives a brilliant pass inside the box from Thomas Muller, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the middle of the goal. He makes it 3:0.
16' The free kick is taken short by Wolfsburg.
15' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Wolfsburg will take a free kick.
13' 2 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) was set free in the area by Thomas Muller and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the top right corner. 2:0.
11' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Bastian Dankert saw the whole situation.
11' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
10' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
7' Bayern Munich are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
4' 1 - 0 Alphonso Davies plays a neat ball into the path of Lovro Zvonarek (Bayern Munich), who makes room for a shot and sends in a low drive which bounces in off the left post! 1:0.
3' Bayern Munich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Wolfsburg will kick-off.
